units.source_text: 那天早晨，终于到了上学的时刻，从底苑寺出来时，我的身心疲惫，颓丧极了。

en.t: That morning, when it was finally time to go to school and I left Teionji, I was exhausted in body and spirit, and utterly dejected.

units.source_text: 上课听课也听不过去，回答老师也是答非所问，引起了哄堂大笑。

en.t: In class, I could not take in the lesson, and when I answered the teacher, my replies missed the point, drawing laughter from the whole room.

units.source_text: 只有柏木漠不关心地眺望着窗外。

en.t: Only Kashiwagi gazed out the window with complete indifference.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，他早已察觉到我内心的这出戏。

en.t: Without a doubt, he had long since noticed this drama unfolding inside me.
